description: The conformance rules every profile inherits. A suite runs them in this order. Profiles add rules beside these and never remove one. Every rule must have a scripted defect in the profile's test suite that makes exactly that rule report a violation.

rules.expectation: The manifest's command starts the plugin and its stdout accepts a request.
The handshake's protocolVersion names a profile the host supports; anything else is refused before any other method is called.
The handshake response is an instance of the committed envelope schema, profile fields included.
A request whose method is not in the profile receives a refusal carrying code -32601 and the request's id, and the connection continues.

A malformed request receives a refusal carrying code -32700 instead of no answer; the refusal carries id 0 when the plugin cannot determine the request's id; the next well-formed request is still answered.
After every other rule has been run, the plugin is still running and still answers handshake.
